title: Verification code and data for: The Barnes-Gindikin Symbol at Fractional Rank
description:
Exact-arithmetic verification scripts, figure sources, environment lockfile, and complete finite-cutoff data supporting the paper The Barnes-Gindikin Symbol at Fractional Rank: Continuation Without a Determinant Carrier, Positivity Without a Cone.

The entry point is verify_positivity.py, which recomputes every displayed positivity locus, erosion degree, and tabulated finite-cutoff example of Sections 8-11 in exact rational arithmetic, by algebraic cell decomposition of the real line checked against exhaustive enumeration of all partitions up to the relevant degree.
